retell: A finance woman has to send the board pack at 9:00 but the deck says €71–73m and the model says €74.6m.
Forty-five minutes earlier she asked a chatbot to update things; it said 'Done' three times while breaking the memo formatting, regenerating the deck and losing slide 4.
Then Agentic Office takes one request, changes one cell, one sentence and the exact slide elements as tracked changes, and she reviews all 10, including slide 4.
She sends the files, the sun comes up, and the line is 'AI said it was done. This time, you checked.'
